question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

The breakdown in power supply was causing by a defective transformer.
solution:
The correct answer is- 'was causing by.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in Part (was causing by) of the sentence.
 
• As the** given sentence is in the Simple past tense and passive voice, the structure should be: Object+ was/were + V3 + by + Subject. **
 
 
• Example: *Football was played by us.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the use of 'causing' should be replaced by 'caused' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Correct sentence__:* The breakdown in power supply was **caused** by a defective transformer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, the sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: *He reads a novel. *(Active Voice)

 * A novel is read by him. *(Passive Voice)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 

 
• त्रुटि वाक्य के Part (was causing by) में है।
 
• जैसा कि दिया गया वाक्य सिंपल पास्ट टेंस और पैसिव वॉयस में है, संरचना इस प्रकार होनी चाहिए: Object+ was/were + V3 + by + Subject।
 
 
• Example: *Football was played by us.*
 
 
 
• इसलिए वाक्य में 'casuing' के प्रयोग को 'caused' से बदल देना चाहिए ताकि वह व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही हो।​
